name: What steps are involved in the whole home interior painting process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the whole home interior painting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation and estimate. Once approved, we schedule the work. Before painting, we meticulously prepare all surfaces by cleaning, sanding, patching holes, and masking off areas not to be painted. Furniture and floors are protected with drop cloths. Primer is applied as needed, followed by two coats of your chosen paint. Throughout the project, we maintain a tidy workspace. Finally, we conduct a thorough cleanup and a final walkthrough with you to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, surface preparation, protecting furniture, priming, two coats of paint, cleanup, and a final walkthrough.
